title: Who is Encore? Wuthering Waves
sources: https://wutheringwaves.kurogames.com official news 714 'Profile Reveal: Consultant from the Black Shores — Encore': a quirky girl always with a black and a white Wooly plushie named Cosmos and Cloudy. Key art quote: 'Hee-hee, Hi there! I'm Encore from the Black Shores! Wanna go on an adventure with me and my Woolies?' Affiliation Black Shores, Attribute Fusion, 5 stars

scenes.narration: Hi there! I'm Encore from the Black Shores! Wanna go on an adventure with me and my Woolies? This is Encore, in Wuthering Waves.
Her Woolies are Cosmos, a short-tempered knight in shining armor, and Cloudy, a kind-hearted princess still finding her courage.
Once, she wished on a shooting star for sausage omelet rolls, with two whole sausages. The next morning, there they were. One was a little burnt.
Watering flowers, or saving the world? Encore's answer: what's there to think about? She wants to ride all the rides!
In her Resonance Liberation, her hair turns fluffy like sheep's wool, and sheep horns can appear. You're in for it now!
But behind the smile: her Woolies were a gift from her mom. And in her dreams, she asks: can you hug me a little?
She's a five-star Fusion Resonator. So, would you give Encore a hug? Tell me in the comments.
